title: ts-quality: approve the useful-native wave
description: Review my suggestions and adjust as needed. Inventory and independent inspection are complete. Choices approve design and task authoring, not implementation, publication, retirement or deletion. Unknown receivers remain held.

questions.question: Adopt correctness → bounded experiments → outcome navigation → package/CI summaries?

content.source: Correct reproduced gaps and preserve useful operator jobs without cloning unsafe internals. G2–G11 are independent choices, not blanket-approved by G1.

options: Adopt the native wave; retain separately listed holds
Hold the design for revision
questions.recommended: Adopt the native wave; retain separately listed holds

questions.question: Loose-equality mutation probes (runtime == / !=)?

content.source: Meaningful JS probes present in legacy; require AST/type safety. No external demand was found.

options: Retain valid runtime probes with AST/type-safety tests
Hold until a concrete caller establishes need
questions.recommended: Retain valid runtime probes with AST/type-safety tests

questions.question: Parallel mutation workers?

content.source: Legacy generated missions default to one worker; no measured external demand was found.

options: Serial first; hold parallelism pending measured need/isolation proof
Plan a separate measured parallel-worker implementation
questions.recommended: Serial first; hold parallelism pending measured need/isolation proof

questions.question: Baseline-relative timeout factor?

content.source: The confirmed receiver uses fixed 15000ms; no customized factor receiver was found.

options: Fixed budgets first; hold factor policy pending measured need
Retain a documented opt-in factor after measurement
questions.recommended: Fixed budgets first; hold factor policy pending measured need

questions.question: Coverage lookup convenience?

content.source: Preserve convenience with explicit input identity. Neither option treats missing coverage as covered.

options: Generate/discover target-owned coverage and record an explicit path
Retain opt-in ordered lookup with provenance/ambiguity refusal
questions.recommended: Generate/discover target-owned coverage and record an explicit path

questions.question: Old CLI/API/types/JSON/exit/root-script interfaces?

content.source: No external legacy receiver was found in the bounded scan; private/global absence is unknown. Recommended choice accepts no implicit loss.

options: Native interfaces/exact caller adapters; hold unknown old-interface losses
Plan wholesale legacy interface compatibility
questions.recommended: Native interfaces/exact caller adapters; hold unknown old-interface losses

questions.question: Native destination package topology?

content.source: Matches the existing native installed contract without authorizing publication or legacy package/tag discontinuation.

options: One native staged package; hold legacy package/tag/receiver discontinuation
Keep separate-component design open pending receiver needs
questions.recommended: One native staged package; hold legacy package/tag/receiver discontinuation

questions.question: Offline release preview/inspection diagnostics?

content.source: The legacy release workflow uses these jobs. Diagnostic success must never grant publishing permission.

options: Retain read-only diagnostics outside quality-core authority
Hold diagnostics pending more operator demand
questions.recommended: Retain read-only diagnostics outside quality-core authority

questions.question: Legacy preservation, settlement and possible removal?

content.source: No approved durable archive destination, custody freeze, settlement or deletion permission exists. Admission planning proves none of those effects.

options: Create held admission obligations only; preserve checkout/unknown receivers
Do not author settlement obligations yet; retain them under AK6585
questions.recommended: Create held admission obligations only; preserve checkout/unknown receivers

questions.question: Automatic declaration-level incremental selection?

content.source: Distinct from cache reuse and explicit targeting, which remain retained. No external declaration-sidecar need was found.

options: Hold pending a real job and fresh-binding specification
Plan a separate opt-in declaration-selection task
questions.recommended: Hold pending a real job and fresh-binding specification

questions.question: Workspace-wide aggregate LCOV?

content.source: Per-package coverage is concrete; aggregate demand is unresolved. Package indexing is not aggregate execution proof.

options: Hold pending a multi-package job/provenance specification
Plan a separate target-owned aggregation task
questions.recommended: Hold pending a multi-package job/provenance specification

questions.question: After choices/contracts are recorded, may I commit and close AK6585 as design/task-authoring only?

content.source: Implementation and acceptance obligations remain open; closing AK6585 does not complete the product wave.

options: Yes—commit/close only AK6585 after checks; no implementation/release
Commit the verified slice but leave AK6585 open
questions.recommended: Yes—commit/close only AK6585 after checks; no implementation/release

questions.question: Corrections, additional actual callers, or constraints?

content.source: Optional: name exact private/public receivers if known.
